That said, this production is a good introduction for anyone wanting to know why the likes of me rate the man as the greatest playwright of them all.
This Korean Cherry Orchard marks an exceptional new path towards making Chekhov bolder and stronger than ever, even after 125 years.

cn.t: Simon Stone's inventive Korean-language adaptation of Chekhov's classic earns praise for its fresh, funny approach and bold contemporary reimagining, with critics celebrating the production's humor and innovative South Korean setting.
